# pub title
title: "Leaving the Field: Working with Teachers to Integrate Computational Thinking in Mixed-Visual Ability Classrooms’ Activities"

 name: 2026_assets_leaving.png

# short description of the publication
description: "We contribute empirical and conceptual insights into how inclusive programming toolkits can transition from researcher-supported to teacher-led use. Drawing on interviews, co-design sessions, and classroom enactments with teachers, we identify pedagogical, organizational, and operational conditions shaping sustainable appropriation, and derive design implications for supporting this transition."
